settings.general_help: Global settings applied to all feeds.
settings.author_help: Discussions created from feed items will be authored by this user.
settings.show_source_link_help: When enabled, a link to the original article is added at the beginning of each discussion.
settings.queue_published: Discussion created. The item has been removed from the queue.
settings.queue_queued: The item was added to the publication queue. The discussion appears once the queue worker processes it.
settings.queue_clear_confirmation: Skip all pending items? They will never appear in the queue again and will not be re-imported from the feeds.
settings.queue_clear_success: The approval queue has been cleared.
settings.queue_delete_confirmation: Skip this item without publishing it? It will never appear in the queue again and will not be re-imported from the feed.
settings.queue_empty: There are no items waiting for approval.
settings.queue_hint: Press Publish to create a discussion from the item. Only the newest items within each feed's publish limit end up in this queue.
settings.queue_load_error: Could not load the approval queue.
settings.log_hint: last 100 entries, at most 500 are kept
settings.fetch_error: Could not trigger the feed fetch.
settings.feeds_hint: Each row can be edited and is saved on blur. Paused feeds are skipped when fetching.
settings.feeds_delete_confirmation: Delete this feed? Imported items will be kept, but the feed itself and its pending items are removed.
settings.new_feed_url_invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
settings.preview_empty: The feed has no items yet.
settings.preview_error: Could not load the feed preview.
